GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down outside leader. 2nd turn. got to front 200 metres. looked beaten but found enough # Every Chance
Jumped Ok sat 2 Lengths off, pushed aong turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off all clear, battled on well # even effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 900m got its head up momentarily when being restrained to allow runner cross and obtain cover behind that runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths , recovered after tardy start and sat Mid Field Two Wide 4 Lengths 600m, dropped out in Straight # dropped out
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and lost ground. Raced keenly in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away fairly. Pushed fwd & worked to race 2nd Two Wide (3/4L from lead) early . Stayed 2nd Two Wide midrace & pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 500m. Pushed along & bumped 3 Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Weakened Two Wide in straight. Rider queried - elbow action. # On-pace/weakened.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: An inquiry was opened into the positioning of rider right elbow in proximity to another rider which was positioned to his inside rounding the home turn when both runners raced tight. Whilst on the evidence it was not established that any contact was made, rider was nevertheless advised to be mindful of his elbow action in similar circumstances. In respect to the performance, rider advised his mount travelled well in the early and middle stages however failed to respond to his riding in the straight and proved disappointing. A post-race vet exam rev no abs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went to front. led turn. weakened # Every Chance
Jumped Ok Settled Down 2nd holding fence 1 length. went through on fence turn to join leader. just found enough # Every Chance
Jumped Ok went to front. led turn. weakened # Every Chance
Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd 3 Wide 1 length. 3rd turn 3 wide. battled on well # 3 Wide trip

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was contacted on jumping by rnr which shifted in. Over-raced in the early and middle stages and passing the 700m had to be restrained from the heels of rnr. Was held up in the early part of the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down outside leader. 2nd turn. got to front 200 metres. weakened late # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly with its head up.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. looking for run turn 2 lengths. weakened when clear # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Overraced badly for some distance passing the 900m and had to be checked away from heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 3 Wide 5 lengths. got to outside turn 3 lengths. weakened # covered ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 800m commenced to race keenly and raced wide and without cover thereafter.
